Upbit stated that ICON (ICX) may face unresolved or unremedied security incident risks, and that the reasons for ending trading support have not been resolved since the asset was designated as an investment caution asset.

MetaMask Launches Added Protection to Guard Against Red Pill Attacks

MetaMask has launched Added Protection, a security feature that requires the actual outcome of an Ethereum or EVM transaction to match its preview. If the result differs, the transaction automatically fails and users only lose the attempted gas fee. The feature is enabled by default on extension version 13.45 across 13 EVM networks supporting EIP-7702 smart accounts. — link

Just In: Bank of Japan Raises Rates by 25 Bps to 1.25%, Highest Level in Around 31 Years

The Bank of Japan raised its policy rate by 25 basis points from 1.0% to 1.25%, with the decision passing by a 7–2 vote. The BOJ said Japan’s economy is recovering moderately despite some weakness linked to factors including tensions in the Middle East, while underlying inflation is gradually approaching its 2% price stability target. The central bank added that it will continue raising rates and adjust monetary easing if its economic and price outlook is realized. — link

Financial Data and Ratings Giant S&P Global to Acquire Smart Contract Security Firm OpenZeppelin
